## 中文版本说明

### 生成与配置

- 完善技术方案生成设置：按“写什么、知识库、写多少、插图吗、怎么写、导出样式”整理选项，并将项目设置带入后续目录与正文流程。
- 增加字数不达标修复、图表与技术图谱选项，以及导出格式自检及修复入口；改进设置页的滚动、表单编辑和布局。
- 扩展文本模型高级参数，包括多模态、思考强度、上下文和输出上限、并发、温度及请求方式；改进模型参数自动填充。
- 为 AI 请求增加活动计时和无响应恢复信息，改善长时间任务的状态反馈。

### 模板、资信库与导出

- 模板管理加入三种系统预设模板，并完善模板选择和导出样式配置。
- 调整资信库页面的结构、控件与间距，改进企业资料的查看和录入体验。
- 修复章节 Word 预览中段落和代码相互重叠的问题：预览改为从生成的 DOCX 提取正文进行稳定的只读展示。
- 修复 Word 代码块换行与缩进丢失的问题，覆盖 Markdown 代码围栏、HTML 代码块及原模板导出。
- 修复 macOS 打开更新磁盘映像后应用未退出的问题。

## English Release Notes

### Generation and Configuration

- Refined Technical Plan generation settings into scope, knowledge, length, illustrations, writing, and export-style sections, and carried project settings into outline and body generation.
- Added length-repair, diagram, and export-format inspection options, and improved scrolling, form editing, and spacing on the settings screen.
- Expanded text-model controls for multimodal input, reasoning effort, context and output limits, concurrency, temperature, and request mode; improved automatic parameter filling.
- Added AI request activity timing and no-response recovery feedback for long-running tasks.

### Templates, Credentials, and Export

- Added three built-in system templates and improved template selection and export-style configuration.
- Refined the credential library layout and controls for viewing and maintaining company information.
- Fixed overlapping paragraphs and code in section Word previews by extracting content from the generated DOCX into a stable read-only view.
- Fixed lost line breaks and indentation in exported Word code blocks, including Markdown fences, HTML code blocks, and original-template exports.
- Fixed the macOS app remaining open after opening an update disk image.
